policy.authStorage: HTTPOnly cookie session is the only sanctioned mechanism for authentication tokens. Browser-readable storage (localStorage / sessionStorage) MUST NOT hold scopedJwt, jwt, accessToken, refreshToken, externalUserId, or any grc_* identity field.

items.title: Auth tokens written to localStorage in invitation-accept flow
items.introducedBy: pre-existing (predates the Batch-1 git mv; content is unchanged from the legacy 'Shahin-AI Website/frontend' tree)

scope.rationale: Batch 1 was a pure 'git mv' of the active Shahin-AI app to products/shahin-ai/app; no functional code was touched. Batch 2 scope is the canonical Foundation-module move only. Fixing this debt requires a backend session contract + frontend auth refactor and MUST NOT be bundled into a structural batch. Track as a dedicated security batch.

remediation.intent: Replace browser-storage token writes with HTTPOnly + Secure + SameSite=strict session cookies issued by the auth service; remove all client-side identity persistence; rely on /api/me for hydrated user/tenant context.
blocking: auth-service must issue session cookie on /invitation/accept and /invitation/register
gateway must forward Set-Cookie unchanged for product-shell origin
frontend invitation-accept flow must call /api/me after success instead of reading localStorage
delete all read sites that depend on these localStorage keys (scan required before fix)
remediation.estimateLevel: M (cross-service: auth-service + gateway + product-shell + shahin-ai app)
remediation.regressionRisk: HIGH — touches every authenticated route in shahin-ai

compensatingControls.minimumInterim: Document the violation; ensure no NEW localStorage token writes are introduced (CI lint rule recommended).
